title: Bali Couple Highlights with Flights | Nusa Penida, Ubud & Kuta
highlights: Enjoy a stay at carefully selected premium 4-star hotels across Ubud, Kuta & Nusa Penida, offering excellent hospitality & daily breakfast for a seamless tropical getaway.
Round-trip international flights from Delhi to Bali are already included in the package, ensuring a smooth & hassle-free holiday experience right from departure to return.
Bali’s most iconic attractions, cultural experiences, water adventures & sightseeing activities are already pre-included, eliminating the need for separate ticket or activity arrangements.
From airport pickups & hotel transfers to intercity travel, all major transportation throughout the trip is pre-arranged for a smooth & stress-free travel experience.
Complimentary local lunches during selected tours & experiences let you comfortably enjoy Bali’s adventures, scenic explorations & sightseeing without worrying about daytime meal planning.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Flight from Delhi to Bali | Arrival, Beach Walk & Leisure Evening
days.desc: Once you arrive at Ngurah Rai Airport, get transferred to the hotel in Kuta & complete your check-in. After settling in, you can spend the rest of the day exploring Bali at your own pace. You can take a walk along Kuta Beach, famous for its golden sands, lively beach cafés & breathtaking sunset views. You can also explore the local markets in Kuta for souvenirs. For a more elevated experience, you may visit Vue Beach Club, known for its chic beachfront setting & lively music.

days.title: Kuta | Water Sports, Uluwatu Sunset Tour & Kecak Fire-Dance Show
days.desc: Today, gear up for an exciting day in Bali. Begin at Tanjung Benoa Beach & experience the excitement of parasailing high above the turquoise waters, ride across the waves on a jet ski & enjoy the adrenaline rush of flyboarding as you soar above the sea. Then, visit Uluwatu Temple, overlooking the ocean. Here, take in scenic sunset views & witness Kecak Fire Dance, a captivating cultural performance featuring fire acts & scenes inspired by the Ramayana.

days.title: Nusa Penida | Transfer & West Island Tour with Snorkelling
days.desc: Check out from the hotel & get driven to Bali Port. Once there, take the speedboat to Nusa Penida Island. Once there, visit the west side of the island. Explore Kelingking Beach, admired for its cliff formation & Angel's Billabong, where waters flow between rocky formations. Don't miss Bubu Beach, offering views of Mount Agung in the distance & enjoy snorkelling in the island’s clear tropical waters. Later, get driven to the hotel. Upon arrival, check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Ubud | Transfer & Balinese Massage
days.desc: Check out & get driven to Nusa Penida port to take the speedboat to Ubud. Once there, get driven for a Balinese massage experience. Relax amidst soothing tropical surroundings as skilled therapists use authentic Balinese healing techniques, aromatic oils, gentle stretches & pressure therapies to refresh your body & mind after your island adventures. After that, board the transfer & get transferred to the hotel. Upon arriving, check in & uniwind for the day.

days.title: Ubud | ATV Ride Experience
days.desc: Get ready for an adventurous experience amidst the lush tropical landscapes of Ubud with an exciting ATV adventure through Bali’s scenic countryside. Board the transfer & get driven to enjoy a thrilling 90-minute double-sharing ATV ride across muddy trails, jungle paths & rugged terrain surrounded by the island’s breathtaking natural beauty. After that, get transferred to Cretya Ubud, where you can enjoy jungle views, relax in the infinity pools & spend time at its beautifully designed terraces.

days.title: Ubud | Kintamani, Coffee Plantation & Jungle Swing
days.desc: Today, set out on a scenic journey through Bali's natural highlights. Visit Kintamani, famous for its views of Mount Batur. Also, explore a traditional coffee plantation & discover Bali’s coffee-making process. Also, visit Tegenungan Waterfall, where cascading waters flowing through dense greenery create a refreshing escape & Tegalalang Rice Terrace, admired for its layered green rice fields. Don't miss Bali Jungle Swing & soar high above the tropical scenery & capture amazing photographs.

days.title: Bali to Delhi | Departure & Flight
days.desc: Today marks the end of your unforgettable journey in Bali. After checking out from your hotel, get transferred to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your onward flight to Delhi. As you bid farewell to the Island of Gods, take back wonderful memories of stunning beaches, breathtaking sunsets, thrilling adventures, scenic island tours, cultural temples, lush tropical landscapes & peaceful moments that made your Bali getaway truly unforgettable.
